description: As a psychologist, I see the sadness, worry, angst, and anxiety that children and families have when the child finally gathers the courage to tell their parents how long they have been experiencing gender dysphoria. Gender Dysphoria involves extreme distress or discomfort caused by the discrepancy between experiencing oneself as a different gender than that assigned at birth. title: A PSYCHOLOGIST'S PERSPECTIVE ON GENDER DYSPHORIA AND TRANSGENDER RIGHTS
